sources.title: Hodgdon Powder Co. product page, H4350® Extreme Rifle® Powder

sources.note: States that ADI exports propellants that Hodgdon Powder Company rebrands; its table pairs ADI AR2209 with H4350.

Composition: Hodgdon SDS "Extruded Rifle Powders", February 2022 (inner sheet "Propellant AR22 Series", Chemwatch 5189-29, version 7.1); the listed ingredients are taken as the whole composition. Nitrogen in the nitrocellulose 12.6 to 13.4 % (Mass fraction of N for powder records, where safety data sheets print none: from pyrocellulose (12.6 %) to guncotton (13.4 %), the US grades in AMCP 706-175, Solid Propellants, Part One, 1964, p. 46). Value at the mean of the 8 vertices of the composition ranges (fractions summing to 100 %) and the mean nitrogen; min and max over that value and the vertices at both nitrogen bounds, extremes between vertices not searched. The inert ingredient taken as a condensed solid with a mean heat capacity of 1200 to 1950 J/(kg K), the vertices solved at both bounds and the value at the middle. sha256 over the solver code and the ingredient data used.

270 training rows of this table (hold-out by cartridge, docs/data/published-loads.md); M3 parameters vivacity, energy fitted by the load-table fit (docs/research/interior-load-table-fit-parameters.md), candidate B; thermochemistry prior; the other values of interior are fixed inputs of the fit; start pressure per row from defaultStartPressure in core: 30.0 MPa at a barrel of 300 mm and longer; below by the bullet construction of the printed bullet type: lead 24.3 MPa, plated 30.9 MPa, jacketed 30.8 MPa, monolithic 50.0 MPa. Effective model parameters, not load data.
